description: This file defines a class 'TemporaryArrayObjectThrowingExceptions' that extends PHP's built-in \ArrayObject. The class overrides all methods to throw exceptions when called, indicating it does not support typical array operations. It is used internally within Drupal's JSON API module to enforce specific behavior.
